text: Room 302 was terribly noisy at night. Could hear traffic until 2am.
Thin walls between rooms. Neighbors' TV was loud after midnight.
Phòng đẹp nhưng ồn, cửa sổ hướng đường nên ngủ khó.
Breakfast buffet felt cheap. Limited fresh fruit and cold eggs.
Ăn sáng nghèo nàn, ít món địa phương, phục vụ chậm.
Breakfast okay but not worth the resort price. Coffee was weak.
Check-in took 45 minutes. Only one staff at the desk on Friday.
Nhận phòng chậm, đợi 40 phút dù đã booking trước.
Housekeeping was friendly and room was cleaned well daily.
Pool and spa area are beautiful. Kids loved the slide.
Decent value for weekend but breakfast and noise issues hurt the stay.
Air conditioning rattled all night in room 210.
Nhân viên lễ tân nhiệt tình nhưng xử lý check-in vẫn lâu.
Same breakfast menu two days in a row. Very disappointing.
Phòng ồn, thiếu cách âm, không ngủ được cuối tuần.
Gym equipment modern. Beach access convenient.
Slow check-in again on Sunday. Need more front desk staff.
Buffet sáng ít lựa chọn cho trẻ em, bánh mì khô.
Concierge helped book tours quickly. Excellent attitude.
Price high for what you get. Noise and breakfast are recurring themes in reviews.
